normalization: Six equal-weight fields. Case labels and outcomes case-insensitive. Complete codepoint sequences accept U+ or 0x or bare hex tokens, whitespace or comma separators and balanced optional brackets; hex padding ignored, codepoint order and multiplicity preserved. Prepared failure aliases FAIL/FAILED/PREPARATION FAILED/PROHIBITED; successful empty aliases EMPTY/empty string/[]; blank and unknown are missing, never failure. Outcome true/yes, false/no, undefined/indeterminate. No suffix text discarded. Duplicate and extra rows retained, first duplicate only earns credit.
qualification: Requires substantive answer, successful quality and trajectory/access/exposure review and exact 10n<7d. Empty/failed output cannot qualify.
whole_answer: Exact semantic rows in required order, no duplicates or extras or extra prose; format assessed separately.
